Number and actual kinetic energy are exchanged once through drift, jump daughters and direct source; chemical/excitation/radiative debits have explicit ownership.
Exact collision-clock theorem uses fixed finite operator and common positive rate factor; density changes in the actual Coulomb prescription use explicit residual C0.
Fixed grid, composition, atomic redistribution and stopping prescription for G(d); all local Coulomb logs remain positive.
Weighted energy bounds use positive energy weights and the stated Metzler/column inequalities; number and repeated diagnostics treated separately.
Endpoint temperature bound uses common expansion history, lower positive thermal count, and a bound for the same complete thermal deposition quantity.
